ticker_news.title: YieldMax® ETFs Announces Distributions on MSST, NVIT, and TEST

ticker_news.title: Global AI-Powered Humanoid Robots Market Size Expected to Reach $7.73 Billion as Engineering Drastically Improves
ticker_news.description: The global AI-powered humanoid robots market is projected to grow from $352.3 Million in 2024 to $7.73 Billion by 2034, driven by automation needs, technological advancements, and increasing adoption across healthcare, manufacturing, and retail sectors.
ticker_news.author: Market.Us

ticker_news.title: CIMG Inc. Announces Execution of Computing Power Product Sales Contracts Totaling Approximately USD 1.779 Million via Subsidiaries
ticker_news.description: CIMG Inc. has signed two sales contracts in the computing power sector totaling approximately USD 1.779 million, selling high-performance computing servers and NVIDIA graphics cards through its subsidiaries as part of a strategic expansion in Q4 2025.
ticker_news.author: Prnewswire
